hook_en: He is your refuge in trouble. 🙏
reflect_en: Midweek, before the day gets loud, David chose to sing of God's strength and loving devotion in the morning. Whatever trouble this week holds, God is still your fortress and your refuge.
q_en: What trouble are you facing this week?
x_en: For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
tiktok: Sing of His strength this morning 🙏 Psalm 59:16–17 — He is your refuge in times of trouble
yt_title: My Refuge in Times of Trouble | Psalm 59:16–17 #Shorts
li_open: How a leader starts the morning shapes the whole day.
li_quote: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
li_body: David began his day by praising God's strength before facing his troubles. Leaders who start with prayer and praise, and make room for their people to bring their troubles to God, give their teams a refuge that doesn't depend on how the week goes.
hook_es: Él es tu refugio en la angustia. 🙏
reflect_es: A mitad de semana, antes de que el día se llene de ruido, David decidió cantar la fortaleza de Dios y loar de mañana Su misericordia. Sea cual sea la angustia de esta semana, Dios sigue siendo tu amparo y tu refugio.
x_es: Yo empero cantaré tu fortaleza, y loaré de mañana tu misericordia: porque has sido mi amparo y refugio en el día de mi angustia.
key_en: my refuge in times of trouble
